_about: NIS2 transposition status per EU and EEA country, as rendered by the public tracker at https://reglyze.com/en/nis2-tracker. Stages: not_transposed, draft, adopted, in_force, enforcing. `tier` says how a row was established: `verified` rows carry a statute identity verified at the official publication; `provisional` rows are either honest first drafts (lastVerifiedAt null) or sourced records (lastVerifiedAt and sources set) that still await a native reviewer. Every dated fact of a sourced or verified row traces to legal-sources/<country>.md. This file is the curated base layer shipped in the product's code; the live page merges on top of it a database overlay written by a weekly automated sweep of the official sources and by operator verifications, each change carrying its own citation. Dates are ISO 8601. Greece is EL.
